scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of a bearded man stepping from an open stone doorway, an empty cuff and chain behind him. Beside him, a younger woman comforts an older woman with a hand over her heart. All look upward to the left in warm sunlight beneath olive branches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The courtyard is an imaginative grouping of those addressed by the promise, not a narrated historical event. The open door and empty cuff evoke liberty; a comforting hand and hopeful faces evoke care for the brokenhearted. The unseen herald keeps attention on the recipients without depicting Jesus or giving visible form to the Spirit. The relationship follows the canonical Hebrew's broad themes; the staged word glosses are withheld.
